    s = acct[acct[dim]==val].groupby('date')['unblended_cost'].sum().sort_index()

    best_k, best_diff = None, -1
    vals = s.values
    for k in range(5, len(vals)-5):
        d = vals[k:].mean() - vals[:k].mean()
        if abs(d) > best_diff:
            best_diff, best_k = abs(d), k
    print(f"{dim}={val}: pre={pre.mean():.2f}, post={post.mean():.2f}, delta={post.mean()-pre.mean():.2f}, "
          f"best change point={s.index[best_k].date()}")

change_check('cloud_service','z9l3Q')
